Para contar casos hay que responder dos: To count cases you must answer two questions: whether order matters and whether repetition is allowed. If order matters and k of n distinct elements are chosen without repetition, they are variations; if all are used as well, permutations. If order does not matter, combinations.

La probabilidad de la unión suma las de: The probability of the union adds those of each event and subtracts the intersection, which would have been counted twice. The conditional is the probability of A knowing that B has occurred.
Dos sucesos son independientes si saber: Two events are independent if knowing that one occurs does not change the probability of the other: P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B). They are mutually exclusive if they cannot occur at the same time (P(A ∩ B) = 0); if both have non-zero probability, they are never independent. De Morgan's laws say that the complement of the union is the intersection of the complements.
Si las causas A₁, …, Aₙ forman un sistem: If the causes A₁, …, Aₙ form a complete system (they are pairwise exclusive and add up to 1), the probability of an event B is the sum of what each branch of the tree contributes. Bayes' theorem gives the probability of each cause knowing that B has occurred.
Las probabilidades P(Aᵢ) son las <b>a pr: The probabilities P(Aᵢ) are the prior ones and the P(Aᵢ | B), the posterior ones. That is why a very reliable medical test can give many false positives if the disease is rare: the prevalence weighs heavily in P(B).
Una variable aleatoria discreta X toma u: A discrete random variable X takes a few values, each with its probability. These probabilities form the probability function: none is negative and all add up to 1. The distribution function F(x) accumulates the probability up to x, so it rises in jumps from 0 to 1.
La esperanza es el valor medio que saldr: The expected value is the mean value that would come out if the experiment were repeated many times, and the standard deviation measures how far the values stray from that mean. A linear change Y = aX + b moves the mean just like the values, but the variance does not notice the shift b and is multiplied by a².
Cuando un problema da los casos cruzados: When a problem gives the crossed cases of two characteristics (those who play sport and smoke, those who play sport and do not smoke…), the most convenient thing is a 2 × 2 table with its totals. The probabilities of each event come from the row and column totals; the intersection, from the cell where they cross; and a conditional, by keeping a single row or column and dividing by its total.
